march/db#openDb.tr: IndexedDB veritabanı açar: depolar, dizinler, sorgular, işlemler, canlı sorgular; IndexedDB yoksa bellekte çalışır.

march/vault#_resetVaults.name: _resetVaults
march/vault#_resetVaults.doc: Tests: forget the vaults made so far (the next createVault makes a new one).

march/vault#createVault.name: createVault
march/vault#createVault.doc: The vault of this name (one per name and page: calls with the same name get the same vault).
march/vault#createVault.tr: Kullanıcının parolasıyla şifreli kasa: anahtarlar yalnız bellekte, diskte (IndexedDB) yalnız şifreli veri.

march/vault#passLength.name: passLength
march/vault#passLength.doc: A passphrase's length as the vault counts it (characters, after NFC normalization).
march/vault#passLength.tr: Kasanın saydığı biçimde parola uzunluğu (NFC sonrası karakter).

march/vault#unlockDelay.name: unlockDelay
march/vault#unlockDelay.doc: How long the next try waits after `fails` wrong ones: none for three, then 2^(n-3) s, at most 5 minutes.
march/vault#unlockDelay.tr: Yanlış denemelerden sonra bir sonraki denemeye kadar beklenecek süre (ms).

march/vault#VaultError.name: VaultError
march/vault#VaultError.doc: Why a call failed: "locked" (unlock first), "exists" (create on an existing vault), "short" (passphrase), "wait" (too many wrong tries: `retryIn` ms).

ctor.text: new VaultError(code: VaultError["code"], message: string, retryIn: number = 0): VaultError

members.name: code
members.summary: Why it failed (the kinds above, and "missing": no vault yet, "wrong": the current passphrase is wrong, "hint": the hint gives the passphrase away).

members.name: retryIn
members.summary: With "wait": ms until the next try is allowed.

march/vault#VaultError.tr: Kasa hatası: kilitli, zaten var, yok, kısa parola, bekle, yanlış parola.

march/ai#AiError.name: AiError
march/ai#AiError.doc: Why a request failed, in the user's terms: the key ("auth"), the limit ("rate"), the balance ("quota"), the network, the request ("bad"), the provider ("server"), stopped ("abort").

ctor.text: new AiError(code: AiError["code"], message: string, status: number = 0): AiError

members.name: status
members.summary: The HTTP status (0 when no answer came).

march/ai#AiError.tr: AI isteği hatası kullanıcının dilinde: anahtar, sınır, bakiye, ağ, istek, sağlayıcı, durduruldu.

march/ai#aiKeys.name: aiKeys
march/ai#aiKeys.doc: The AI keys kept in a vault ("ai:key:<provider>:<id>"), and the choices (default provider, model and active key per provider, consent). A key saved by the first version ("ai:key:<provider>", one per provider) is moved over when read.
march/ai#aiKeys.tr: Bir kasadaki AI anahtarları ve seçimler (varsayılan sağlayıcı, sağlayıcı başına model, onay).

march/ai#allProviders.name: allProviders
march/ai#allProviders.doc: The built-in providers and the custom ones known now.
march/ai#allProviders.tr: Yerleşik sağlayıcılar ve şu an bilinen, kullanıcının eklediği sağlayıcılar.

march/ai#chat.name: chat
march/ai#chat.doc: Sends a chat and streams the answer (onText); resolves with the whole answer and the tokens used.
march/ai#chat.tr: Kullanıcının anahtarıyla bir sağlayıcıya sohbet gönderir; yanıtı akış hâlinde verir, harcanan token'ı döndürür.

march/ai#customProvider.name: customProvider
march/ai#customProvider.doc: The provider a custom entry describes.
march/ai#customProvider.tr: Kullanıcının eklediği bir sağlayıcı kaydından (ad, temel adres, biçim) sağlayıcı tanımı.

march/ai#endpointOf.name: endpointOf
march/ai#endpointOf.doc: An https URL, or an http one on this computer (localhost): where a key may go. Null when it is not one.
march/ai#endpointOf.signature: function endpointOf(base: string): { base: string; origin: string; local: boolean } | null

returns.type: { base: string; origin: string; local: boolean } | null

march/ai#endpointOf.tr: Bir anahtarın gidebileceği adres mi: https ya da bu bilgisayarda (localhost) http; değilse null.

march/ai#keyLooksLike.name: keyLooksLike
march/ai#keyLooksLike.doc: A key that looks like another provider's (a hint before saving): the provider it looks like, or null.
march/ai#keyLooksLike.tr: Yapıştırılan anahtar başka bir sağlayıcınınkine benziyorsa o sağlayıcı.

march/ai#listModels.name: listModels
march/ai#listModels.doc: The provider's chat models for this key (also a check that the key works: it throws "auth" when it does not).
march/ai#listModels.signature: function listModels(id: string, key: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<string[]>
march/ai#listModels.tr: Sağlayıcının bu anahtarla kullanılabilen sohbet modelleri (anahtarın çalıştığını da sınar).

march/ai#maskKey.name: maskKey
march/ai#maskKey.doc: A key shown safely: its kind (the provider's prefix, "sk-ant-", at most a quarter of it) and, for a long key, its last four characters; a short key shows next to nothing.
march/ai#maskKey.tr: Anahtarı güvenle gösterir: başı ve son dört karakteri.

march/ai#provider.name: provider
march/ai#provider.doc: A provider by id ("anthropic", "openai", a custom one…); throws for an unknown one.

march/ai#registerProvider.name: registerProvider
march/ai#registerProvider.doc: Makes a custom provider known (aiKeys does it for the ones in its vault); `null` forgets it.
march/ai#registerProvider.signature: function registerProvider(id: string, c: CustomProvider | null): void
march/ai#registerProvider.tr: Kullanıcının bir sağlayıcısını tanıtır (aiKeys kasadakileri kendisi tanıtır); null unutturur.

march/ai#sseEvents.name: sseEvents
march/ai#sseEvents.doc: The data lines of a server-sent event stream (one parsed JSON per event; "[DONE]" ends it).
march/ai#sseEvents.tr: Bir server-sent events yanıtının veri satırları (her olay ayrıştırılmış JSON).

march/props#mProps.name: mProps
march/props#mProps.doc: Apply common props by hand (the compiler writes this call for `m:` attributes): `mProps(h(Card, props), { "no-select": true })`. `target` is what h() returned: an element, a component's output (its root elements get the props; a live region is followed as it changes) or a list of these. A value may be a function (live). Returns the target to render.
march/props#mProps.signature: function mProps<T>(target: T, props: Record<string, unknown>): T
march/props#mProps.tr: Ortak (`m:`) prop'ları elle uygular: `mProps(h(Card, props), { "no-select": true })`. Öğeye ya da bileşenin kök öğelerine yazar; değer fonksiyon olabilir (canlı).

march/props#registerMProp.name: registerMProp
march/props#registerMProp.doc: Add a common prop: `registerMProp("tone", (el, v) => …)` makes `m:tone` work on every element and component. Register before the first render that uses it. A built-in member of the extension pipeline (extend()): the compiler applies `m:` props itself, so it only runs for `h(Comp, { "m:tone": … })` written by hand.
march/props#registerMProp.signature: function registerMProp(name: string, apply: MProp): void
march/props#registerMProp.tr: Yeni bir ortak prop ekler: `registerMProp("tone", (el, v) => …)` ile `m:tone` her öğede ve bileşende çalışır.

march/props#withParts.name: withParts
march/props#withParts.doc: Give props to the components drawn inside `render`, whatever draws them: `m:parts` on any element or component. `<PostCard post={post} m:parts={{ Avatar: { size: "lg" }, LikeButton: { color: "brand-blue" } }} />` compiles to `withParts(new Map([[Avatar, {…}], [LikeButton, {…}]]), () => h(PostCard, {…}))`; write that call by hand in plain JS. Every component of that kind created inside the scope (now or later: a list row, a branch that opens) gets the props; they win over what its parent gave it, the nearest scope wins over an outer one. `parts` may be an accessor: the props that were set when a part was created stay live. A component called as a plain function (not through h() / JSX) is not reached.
march/props#withParts.signature: function withParts<T>(parts: PartsMap | (() => PartsMap | null | undefined), render: () => T): T
march/props#withParts.tr: `m:parts` ortak prop'unun elle yazımı: içeride çizilen bileşenlere türüne göre özellik verir (ebeveynin verdiğini ezer, en yakın kapsam kazanır): `withParts(new Map([[Avatar, { size: "lg" }]]), () => h(PostCard, props))`.

march/app-ui#allPanels.doc: Every panel id in the tree.
